turns.raw:
Presupunând tabelele `clients`, `invoices`, `payments`, `accounts`:

```sql
SELECT i.*
FROM invoices i
JOIN clients c  ON c.id = i.client_id
JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
WHERE c.name = 'β'
  AND a.iban = 'π'
  AND p.paid_at > DATE '2026-01-01';
```
